name: Inventory
description: Track stock levels of warehouse items, record stock movements and spot items that need reordering
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read items and their stock movements; require auth for creating, updating and deleting items and for recording stock movements; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Items: any signed-in user may create, update and delete any item; DELETE /api/items/:id removes the item and its movements permanently

Item validation: name is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; sku a required non-empty string of at most 40 characters, unique across items (a duplicate answers 409); location an optional string of at most 100 characters; quantity a whole number of at least 0 (default 0); reorder_level a whole number of at least 0 (default 5)
Every item in a response carries low_stock, true when quantity is at or below reorder_level
Quantity changes only through stock movements after creation: PUT /api/items/:id replaces name, sku, location and reorder_level and leaves quantity alone

Stock movements: POST /api/items/:id/movements records a non-zero whole-number delta (positive for stock received, negative for stock taken out) with an optional reason of at most 200 characters for the signed-in user and applies it to the item's quantity; a movement that would take the quantity below 0 answers 409 and changes nothing

GET /api/items lists active items sorted by name; ?query= matches name or sku case-insensitively, ?location= keeps items at that exact location, ?low_stock=true keeps only low-stock items, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching item
GET /api/items/:id/movements lists an item's movements newest first
Deactivated items (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/items and answer 404 on the public item endpoints; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a duplicate sku or a movement that would make stock negative
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the inventory table and item details read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit, delete and stock-movement controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to manage inventory' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Inventory table: name, sku, location, quantity and reorder level, with low-stock rows highlighted, a search box, a location filter, a 'Low stock only' switch and previous/next paging

Item detail view: the item's fields and its movement history (date, username, delta, reason, quantity after); signed-in users get 'Receive' and 'Take out' forms that record a movement and update the shown quantity
Add and edit item forms that show the API's validation messages next to the form, including a duplicate sku; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every item, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and the number of low-stock items
Toggle an item's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active items by name, filtered and paged

query.query: Case-insensitive text matched against name and sku
query.location: Only items at this exact location
query.low_stock: true keeps only items at or below their reorder level

api_endpoints.description: Create an item with its opening quantity
Replace an item's descriptive fields (name and sku required; an omitted location is cleared, an omitted reorder_level resets to 5; quantity is unchanged)
Delete an item and its movements
Stock movements of an item, newest first
Record a stock movement and apply it to the item's quantity

data_models.name: Item
data_models.description: A stocked item; low_stock is computed from quantity and reorder_level

fields.name: string (required, max 200 chars)
fields.quantity: integer (min 0, default 0; changed by stock movements after creation)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the item from public endpoints)

data_models.name: StockMovement
data_models.description: One change to an item's quantity

fields.item_id: integer (references Item.id; deleted with the item)
fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who recorded it)
fields.quantity_after: integer (the item's quantity after this movement)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every item with counts
